nodes.label: entrypoint()
nodes.desc: Console script registered as pyproject-build; forwards sys.argv into main().

nodes.label: main()
nodes.desc: Parses flags, resolves the output directory (defaults to srcdir/dist) and routes to the selected build strategy.

nodes.label: _select_build()
nodes.desc: Chooses between metadata printing, explicit --sdist/--wheel and the default build-sdist-then-wheel strategy.

nodes.label: build_package_via_sdist()
nodes.desc: Default strategy: build an sdist, extract it to a clean tree and build the wheel from that extracted source.

nodes.label: build_package()
nodes.desc: Runs one isolated build per requested distribution (sdist, wheel or editable) and collects artifact names.

nodes.label: _bootstrap_build_env()
nodes.desc: Context manager wiring an isolated env (or --no-isolation plus a dependency check) to a ProjectBuilder.

nodes.label: ProjectBuilder
nodes.desc: The PEP 517 consumer API: parses [build-system] and drives backend hooks for sdist, wheel and metadata.

nodes.label: _parse_build_system_table()
nodes.desc: Validates the [build-system] table; falls back to setuptools.build_meta:__legacy__ with setuptools >= 40.8.0.

nodes.label: BuildBackendHookCaller
nodes.desc: From pyproject_hooks (created at _builder.py L217): calls backend hooks in a subprocess with JSON-over-stdio.

nodes.label: DefaultIsolatedEnv
nodes.desc: Context-managed temporary venv; PATH and PYTHONPATH are rewritten so builds never see the host environment.

nodes.label: _PipBackend / _UvBackend
nodes.desc: Two pluggable installers behind one protocol: venv/virtualenv plus pip by default, uv as an opt-in alternative.
